text:
Hi there! 👋 Thanks for reaching out to Leafy!

**Express shipping costs $14.95**, no matter your order size or location.

A couple of things to keep in mind:
- Express is **not available for XL plants** (usually over 4 ft) — those ship Standard only
- Express is **never free**, even for Leafy Plus members
- Delivery times vary by zone:
  - **Zone 1** (under 300 miles): next business day
  - **Zone 2** (300–1,000 miles): 2 business days
  - **Zone 3** (over 1,000 miles, remote/island): Express not available

If you have any other questions about shipping or your order, I'm here to help! 🌱
